Offshore energy platform.provides: no ground-based defence within range, helicopter access only

Urban government district.provides: no kinetic engagement possible over the population, dense sensor coverage

Kinetic engagement.provides: certain destruction of the airframe, falling debris

Track and do not engage.provides: intelligence gained, the incursion completes unimpeded

Airframe defeated before the objective.provides: no damage, wreckage available for exploitation

Collateral harm from the response.provides: own-goal consequences, public and legal exposure
